description.value: Two Scoop Steve is a seasonal ice cream stop and Garden Bistro tucked into the small historic community of Yahk in the Kootenays, serving 24 flavours of hard ice cream alongside breakfast and lunch. The bistro features outdoor-only seating, making it a breezy trailside-style pause for cyclists passing through on the highway. It sits next door to Yahk Soap & Candle Co., giving it a relaxed village-stop character.
